description.value:
Prerequisites: Craft Staff feat

The white mage's research has unlocked a new power in conjunction with using a wand. Similar to using a magic staff, she uses her own Wisdom score and relevant feats to set the DC for saves against spells she casts from a wand, and she can use her caster level when activating the power of a wand if it's higher than the caster level of the wand.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - White Mage (Advanced Mage Talents)
